text: dsh-plugin-translation 是面向 DSH agent 的翻译辅助工具，可在宿主中注册 translate_kit 工具并加入翻译提示指导。它让模型负责翻译，工具负责文本分段、候选术语提取、源文与译文检查、语气指南生成和术语一致性核对。用户还可保存并查询翻译记忆、术语表与语气指南，并用启发式评分查看译文质量。记忆文件保存在 DSH 会话工作区。适合需要处理长文本、保持术语统一或检查数字与括号的翻译流程；无需额外 API Key。

dsh-plugin-translation adds a DSH translation tool for chunking text, extracting terms, checking source and target, and saving glossaries, translation memories, and tone guides in the session workspace. It also offers terminology consistency checks and heuristic quality scores.
想把长文切成适合逐段翻译的小块
有没有工具能从原文里提取术语候选并统计出现次数
帮我检查译文中的数字、括号和长度比例是否与原文一致
我想给不同语言和语域生成翻译语气指南
如何在多个翻译片段之间检查术语译法是否统一
想保存常用原文和译文，下次翻译时再查出来
I need to keep a reusable glossary for consistent translations.
Can I score a translation for number fidelity and fluency issues?
把长文本按句子切分为有序片段，并在片段超过设定字符上限时继续拆分。通过 translate_kit 的 segment 动作输入原文和 maxLen，得到带编号的文本片段。
从文本提取首字母缩写、驼峰词、编码、域名、数字单位、邮箱和 URL 等候选术语，并统计出现次数。调用 translate_kit 的 glossary 动作输入原文，返回术语列表。
对照源文和译文，检查数字单位、括号配对、长度比例及重复标点等问题。调用 translate_kit 的 check 动作提交 source 与 target，可获得通过状态和问题列表。
在 DSH 会话工作区维护翻译记忆、术语表和语气指南。使用 memo、glossary、tone 对应动作读取、添加或删除条目，文件路径和保留数量可通过配置调整。

dsh-plugin-translation README · dsh-plugin-translation：A **translation toolkit** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agents: chunking, glossary extraction, source–target QA, tone guides, and a durable translation memory. The model translates; the plugin chunks, checks, and remembers.

dsh-plugin-translation README · Compatibility：Tool schemas are validated against the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` value-schema DSL at plugin load (checked against dsh-tools 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2). Earlier releases used JSON-Schema `required` at the root of `output.schema` and closed nested objects without declared properties, which made the host abort the whole profile boot with `unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL` and could reject the tool's own results. Current releases fix both; if an affected version left your DSH unable to start, remove the plugin from the profile (or upgrade) — no data is lost.

dsh-plugin-translation README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-translation
```

Restart DSH. The `translate_kit` tool is registered host-wide.

dsh-plugin-translation README · Tool：| action | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `segment` | Split text into numbered, bounded chunks for chunked translation |
| `glossary` | Extract candidate terms (acronyms, camelCase, domains, numbers+units, emails, URLs) with counts |
| `check` | Source–target QA: numbers/units, brackets, length ratio, doubled punctuation |
| `tone` | Register-specific tone guide (formal / colloquial / technical, en / zh) |
| `memo_get` | Read the translation memory (newest first) |
| `memo_add` | Save a source→target pair to the memory file in the session workspace |
| `glossary_get` | Read the durable glossary (newest first) |
| `glossary_add` | Add or update a source→target glossary term in the workspace glossary file |
| `glossary_remove` | Remove a glossary term by source |
| `consistency` | Cross-segment terminology consistency check against the glossary |
| `tone_get` | Read saved tone guides (filterable by tone and language) |
| `tone_save` | Save a tone guide for a tone@language pair |
| `quality` | Heuristic quality score (0-100) with fidelity/fluency breakdown |

dsh-plugin-translation README · Config：| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `personaSection` | `true` | register the translation prompt-guidance section |
| `sectionOrder` | `6` | prompt section order (persona is 0, ascending) |
| `memoFile` | `.dsh/translation-memo.md` | memory file path (relative to the session workspace; cannot escape it) |
| `glossaryFile` | `.dsh/translation-glossary.md` | glossary file path (relative to the session workspace; cannot escape it) |
| `maxGlossaryEntries` | `200` | entries kept in the glossary file |
| `toneFile` | `.dsh/translation-tone.md` | tone-memory file path (relative to the session workspace) |
| `maxToneEntries` | `50` | saved tone guides kept |
| `maxMemoEntries` | `200` | entries kept in the memory file |

dsh-plugin-translation README · Design：Pure logic (`lib/translation.js`) has zero DSH/Cordis imports and is unit-tested in isolation; `lib/index.js` is the thin Cordis plugin. Memory access goes through `ctx.fs` and every resolved path is containment-checked against the session workspace.

dsh-plugin-translation README · Roadmap：See [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md) — next five versions (v0.2.0 – v0.6.0): glossary management & consistency, tone memory & quality scoring, side-by-side diff & placeholder protection, conflict detection & effort stats, glossary versioning & batch pipeline.
